extraction.tool: pdftotext (poppler) without -layout, page 8; bidi control marks removed; cell lines joined with a space
extraction.text_layer_defect: The PDF text layer encodes every lam-alif ligature (لا لأ لإ لآ) as the reversed pair (ال أل إل آل), and places some commas before the preceding space. The glyphs drawn on the page are correct.
extraction.correction_rule: term_ar / usage_note_ar are the text layer with ONLY these defects undone. scripts/verify_dictionary_extract.py checks, for every field, that re-applying the defect (lam-alif -> reversed pair) and removing whitespace and diacritics yields exactly the text layer with whitespace and diacritics removed; and, when the package PDF is available locally, that each text_layer string occurs in a fresh extraction.
